exposure.unit: one eligible persisted impression event, not one served candidate
exposure.identity: impression event_id; exact replays deduplicated; conflicting reuse rejected
exposure.eligibility: exporter attests foreground viewability threshold, consent, valid serve item, and snapshot prediction lineage
exposure.denominator: mature eligible uniquely attributed impressions with head-specific complete observation coverage
exposure.repeated_exposure: multiple distinct impression IDs with the same key are ambiguous; exclude labels rather than guess last touch
exposure.watermark: observation_cutoff attests client-time coverage after delivery-lag reconciliation, never wall clock alone
exposure.missing: missing coverage, initial state or short dwell is unknown, never implicit zero
exposure.censored: window ends after observation_cutoff; exclude all head labels even if a positive arrived early
exposure.identity_limit: null serve/position and product actions without exact attribution must be quarantined by exporter; no user/repo-only join

ctr.target: README/details-open rate per impression (proposed meaning of CTR)
ctr.label: 1 if at least one attributed open in window; otherwise 0 only with mature complete coverage
ctr.reversals: closing details does not reverse an open
ctr.compatibility: synthetic generic CTR is not established to mean README-open; retraining/requalification required

save.target: new repository save retained at window end among initially unsaved items
save.label: terminal attributed save state; initial_saved must be false; unknown or already saved excluded
save.reversals: unsave cancels save; later save restores it; simultaneous conflicting transitions are ambiguous
save.missing_censored: exclude missing baseline, incomplete coverage or unfinished window; require all membership-origin transitions in export

gh_open.target: explicit Open GitHub action per impression, not confirmed external page load
gh_open.label: 1 if any attributed event in window; otherwise 0 with mature complete coverage
gh_open.reversals: no reversal; repeated opens collapse to one positive

dwell.target: maximum reported visibility episode divided by 600 seconds
dwell.label: max observed dwell_ms / 600000; v2 samples are thresholded at 3000ms and capped at 300000ms
dwell.reversals: deduplicate event IDs; use maximum episode rather than sum repeated visibility
dwell.missing_censored: no dwell sample is missing, not zero; incomplete/immature/ambiguous episodes excluded
dwell.compatibility: retains synthetic head's 600-second units for diagnostics only; v2 truncation prevents full-duration calibration; no probability interpretation

follow.target: undecided: product owners must choose repository owner/account/other action
follow.reversals: future source must specify follow/unfollow state, target identity, baseline and causal exposure attribution
follow.missing_censored: always unsupported; never impute zeros, save proxies or account-follow table snapshots
follow.proposed_alternative: evaluate follow weight zero in a new value-function version only after owner approval and paired ranking evaluation; no serving change here

approval_required: save state and repeated exposure attribution
versioned model/value/output migration, evaluation and rollback
